subject: Delta Finance - KEK wrapping proof and rotation debrief
messages:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan@deltafin.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: KEK wrapping proof + rotation artifacts for SOC2/CAIQ

Grace —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As part of Delta Finance's SOC2 scoping and our SIG/CAIQ follow-up, security has asked us to collect a compact set of cryptographic artifacts from vendors for the tenant that will hold PII (Delta-prod-1). Specifically we need:

- A signed, timestamped rotation manifest that shows KEK wrapping events for the last 6 months (including sequence numbers and signing key thumbprint).
- A short narrative describing cross-region wrapping behavior and fallbacks when primary region is unavailable.
- Evidence that operator separation is enforced for keystore/ceremony operations (operator matrix or shift logs).
- TLS in-transit cipher suites and proof that gRPC endpoints enforce mTLS for internal control channels.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with checkboxes (delta-kms-questionnaire.xlsx) so you can map artifacts to our questions. Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Ideally we'd get the signed manifest + operator matrix by next Wednesday (2026-09-16) to keep the audit window.

If there are any redlines (e.g., cannot provide raw logs), flag them and propose a partial substitute (signed summaries, redacted snapshots, or auditor-cosigned transfer).

Thanks —
Morgan Ellis
Senior InfoSec Manager
Delta Finance



From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan@deltafin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: KEK wrapping proof + rotation artifacts for SOC2/CAIQ

Morgan —

Appreciate the checklist, and we can absolutely support this request. Quick plan and constraints below.

What we will deliver by 2026-09-16:
- rotation-manifest-20260915.sig (signed manifest containing wrap events for Delta-prod-1 for the last 6 months; includes sequence, wrap-algorithm, thumbprint; signature by our infra signing key).
- operator-separation-matrix.csv (CSV mapping role -> allowed ceremony ops; anonymized operator IDs; shift windows attached).
- TLS cipher list + short config note for control-plane gRPC endpoints (we enforce mTLS for internal control traffic; we'll include cipher suite list and certificate validation requirements).

Items that need a short sync or auditor-escrow:
- Raw HSM shift logs: we cannot share full operator PII or full audit DB exports. We can provide sampled, redacted shift logs and a notarized HSM attestation (hsm-attestation-2026-05.pdf).
- Key ceremony minutes: we maintain minutes for production ceremonies, but these include operator identifiers that are sensitive. We can provide redacted minutes and a signed summary that lists participants by role and the public key fingerprints involved.

Next steps:
1) Ben will stage the signed manifest and operator matrix in a secure share and send a single-use link.
2) Marissa will append the HSM attestation PDF and a short redaction note.
3) I'll reply here with the secure URLs and a brief README mapping files to your questionnaire.

If that timeline works, we'll proceed. If you need the raw logs for an independent auditor, we can arrange an auditor-attended transfer under NDA; please let us know.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: KEK wrapping proof + rotation artifacts for SOC2/CAIQ

Grace / Ben / Marissa —

Thank you — this looks good and the secure link works. A couple of clarifications before we close the ticket:

1) For the rotation manifest signature: which key was used to sign (thumbprint provided) — can you confirm rotation of your signing key itself over the last 12 months, or point to a public audit entry? We need to demonstrate auditor traceability for signature keys.

2) For operator separation: the matrix is fine, but can you include a single example redacted shift log (one 24-hour window) that shows role transitions and the associated shift-ticket IDs? Redaction should remove operator email/SSO but keep OP-IDs and timestamps.

3) TLS: can you confirm your control-plane enforces TLS1.3 for internal control gRPC and show the effective cipher list (not just configuration) — a short capture or a server config dump is fine.

If you can add the two small items (signing-key rotation trace + one sample redacted shift log + TLS capture) by EOD Monday, we'll include these in our auditor package. If any of these require an auditor witness, let us know and we'll schedule.

Regards,
Morgan Ellis
Senior InfoSec Manager
Delta Finance
